name: org.humsaadhak.HumSaadhakApplication
comment: HumSaadhak 2.0 — one Spring Boot application, twelve business modules. Each top-level package below this one is a Spring Modulith module; see ModularityTests.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit
comment: Change history. Hibernate Envers writes a *_aud row for every change to audited entities; this module stamps each revision with the user who made it and turns consecutive revisions into readable "field: before -> after" lists.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.config.AuditConfig
comment: Wires the audit trail: the advisor around @AuditAction methods and the request interceptor for /api.

methods.name: auditAdvisor
methods.comment: Ordered before method security (@PreAuthorize) so refused calls are recorded, and before the services' own transactions so they join the transaction the audit record is written in.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.controller.AuditController
comment: GET /api/v2/audit/trail: one record's audit trail (anyone who can see the record); GET /api/v2/audit/activity: recent actions in a page's area; GET /api/v2/audit/events(.csv): the full log (audit.view).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.controller.HistoryController
comment: GET /api/v2/history/{type}/{id}: readable change history of one record, newest first (staff only).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dao.AuditDao
comment: The audit_event table: append-only (a database trigger refuses updates and deletes). Every query is fixed; filters only add bound parameters.

methods.name: forTarget
methods.comment: Every recorded action on one record, newest first (at most 500).

methods.name: activity
methods.signature: activity(java.util.List, java.lang.Long, java.lang.Long, boolean, int, int)
methods.comment: Actions in some categories: everything for staff (org null), or what concerns one organisation, or one person's own actions (actorId set).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dao.HistoryDao
comment: Reads Envers revisions of one record, oldest first, with who made each change.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dto.Actor
comment: Who acted, as recorded (a snapshot: later renames do not change past records).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dto.AuditEntry
comment: One line of an audit trail: who did what to which record, when, from where, how it ended and which fields changed. ip and userAgent are filled only for people with audit.view.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dto.AuditFilter
comment: Filters of the full audit log (all optional). Dates are inclusive, in India time.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dto.HistoryEntry
comment: One revision of a record; requestId links it to the audited action that made it (null for older or system changes).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.dto.NewAuditEvent
comment: An audit record about to be written.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.entity.AuditRevision
comment: Envers revision with the acting user's email and the request that made it, so history shows who changed what and why.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.entity.UsernameRevisionListener
comment: Fills AuditRevision.username from the signed-in user (or "system" for scheduled jobs) and the audited request's id.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.model.AuditedType
comment: Records whose change history can be shown, and their Envers audit tables (an allow-list: user input never reaches SQL).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.model.Outcome
comment: How an audited action ended: done, refused (no permission or not their record), or failed (a rule or an error).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.service.AuditMethodInterceptor
comment: Around every @AuditAction controller method: runs the action and writes its audit record in one transaction, so a change is never committed without its record. If the action is refused or fails, the transaction rolls back and the attempt is recorded on its own. Runs outside method security so refusals by @PreAuthorize are recorded too.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.comment: Developer-written SpEL over the method's parameters and #result; anything it cannot evaluate is left out.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.service.AuditMethodInterceptor$Wrapped
comment: Carries a checked exception out of the transaction callback.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.service.AuditRecorder
comment: Writes audit records. Joins the caller's transaction when there is one, so an action and its record commit together.

methods.name: currentActor
methods.comment: The signed-in person, or null for anonymous requests (sign-in, registration, password links).

methods.name: owners
methods.comment: Organisations that may see the record's trail; a failing lookup never blocks the action.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.service.AuditRequestInterceptor
comment: Starts the audit context of each audited request (request id, client address, browser) and records requests that never reached the method, such as invalid input. The request id is returned in X-Request-Id for support.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.service.AuditTrailService
comment: Audit trails for the pages where changes are made, and the full audit log.

methods.name: trail
methods.comment: Everything done to one record, newest first, each action with the fields it changed.

methods.name: activity
methods.comment: What happened in some areas: everything for staff, otherwise what concerns the person's organisation (or only their own actions).

methods.name: search
methods.comment: The full audit log (audit.view).

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.service.HistoryService
comment: Readable change history of a record, newest first.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.util.AuditActions
comment: Readable names for action codes, their categories, and how an HTTP status maps to an outcome (pure, unit-tested).

methods.name: label
methods.comment: "purpose.update" -> "Edited the purpose"; an unknown code is shown as it is.

methods.name: category
methods.comment: "purpose.update" -> "purpose": the group a page shows.

methods.name: outcomeForStatus
methods.comment: 401/403 are refusals; any other error status is a failure.

methods.name: clip
methods.comment: Trims text to fit a column, marking the cut.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.util.AuditTrailMerge
comment: Joins a record's recorded actions with the field changes Envers kept for it (pure, unit-tested). Both carry the id of the request that made them, so each action shows what it changed; changes no action explains (scheduled jobs, the legacy migration, edits from before the audit trail existed) appear on their own lines.

methods.name: redact
methods.comment: Without the client address and browser, for people without audit.view.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.util.AuditVisibility
comment: Who may see what in the audit trail (pure, unit-tested).

methods.name: canSeeTrail
methods.comment: Staff see every record's trail; others only the trails of records their organisation owns or shares.

methods.name: seesEverything
methods.comment: Refused and failed attempts, IP addresses and browsers are shown only with the audit.view permission.

name: org.humsaadhak.audit.util.HistoryDiff
comment: Turns consecutive audit rows into "what changed" entries (pure, unit-tested). Technical columns are ignored so people only see business fields.

methods.name: label
methods.comment: commitment_amount -> Commitment amount

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.api
comment: The catalogue module's public interface: the only types other modules may use (checked by ModularityTests).

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.api.Catalogue
comment: Read access for matching, giving and reporting.

methods.name: createNeed
methods.comment: Creates a draft need and opens its approval (used by the importer).

methods.name: createPurpose
methods.comment: Creates a draft purpose and opens its approval (used by the importer).

methods.name: recordPayment
methods.comment: Called by giving inside the donation transaction so raised amounts never drift.

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.api.CatalogueEvents
comment: Published when a purpose or need becomes (or stops being) searchable. Ids only.

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.api.NeedKind
comment: Causes (schools) and projects (NGOs) are one concept in 2.0.

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.controller.CatalogueController
comment: Purposes (what donors want to fund) and needs (causes of schools, projects of NGOs).

methods.name: openNeeds
methods.comment: Approved, still-open causes and projects: what donors can browse and give to directly.

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.entity.Need
comment: A school cause or an NGO project. Fixes D8: completed only when the target is raised.

methods.name: addPayment
methods.comment: Adds a payment; the need completes when the money raised reaches the target.

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.entity.Purpose
comment: A donor's funding intent. Approval state lives in the workflow module.

name: org.humsaadhak.catalogue.service.CatalogueAuditOwnership
comment: A purpose's trail belongs to its donor; a cause's or project's to its school or NGO.

methods.name: recordPayment
methods.comment: Money received moves the funding progress; a fully funded need leaves the search index.

methods.name: ownerOrg
methods.comment: Staff may act for any organisation; external users only for their own.

methods.name: purposesFor
methods.comment: Staff see every purpose; a donor sees their own, newest first.

methods.name: needsFor
methods.comment: Staff see every cause and project; a school or NGO sees its own, newest first.

methods.name: openNeeds
methods.comment: Approved, still-open causes and projects (optionally of one sector): what donors can browse and give to directly.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.api
comment: The documents module's public interface: the only types other modules may use (checked by ModularityTests).

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.api.DocumentReviewed
comment: A document was reviewed or rejected; registry recomputes the owner's verification.

methods.name: mandatoryTypeIds
methods.comment: Mandatory document type ids for an organisation type name (DONOR_CORPORATE, SCHOOL, …).

methods.name: latestStateByType
methods.comment: For each document type the organisation uploaded: state of its latest version (PENDING, REVIEWED, REJECTED).

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.api.MandatoryRulesChanged
comment: Published when an administrator changes which documents an organisation type must provide; verification is re-checked.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.api.OrganisationDirectory
comment: Organisation names for screens owned by documents (document requests, review queue). Implemented by the registry module, which already depends on documents: declaring the interface here keeps the dependency one-way (no cycle).

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.client.S3StorageGateway
comment: Works with AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces or MinIO (set humsaadhak.storage.endpoint for the latter two). Every request uses TLS and verifies the storage certificate (public CAs, plus the internal CA for a self-hosted MinIO). Download links are signed for STORAGE_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT when set, so browsers fetch documents over HTTPS from a public address.

methods.name: ensureBucket
methods.comment: A self-hosted MinIO starts empty: with STORAGE_CREATE_BUCKET=true the private documents bucket is created on start-up if it is missing. On AWS the bucket is created with the infrastructure, so this stays off.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.client.StorageGateway
comment: Object storage behind an interface so tests and local runs can swap it.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.controller.DocumentController
comment: Uploading and reviewing documents, downloads, and donors' requests to see a school's or NGO's documents.

methods.name: pending
methods.comment: Staff review queue: newest version of every document still waiting, oldest first.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.controller.DocumentTypeAdminController
comment: Super admins: document types and which organisation types must provide each.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.dao.LegacyDocumentDao
comment: Documents migrated from the legacy system whose files still have to be copied into object storage.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.dto.ShareRow
comment: Names are included so screens never show bare numbers.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.entity.DocumentTypeRule
comment: Which document types are mandatory for which organisation type (fixes D7).

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.entity.ShareRequest
comment: A donor asks to see a matched beneficiary's documents; the beneficiary decides.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.service.DocumentAuditOwnership
comment: A document's trail belongs to its owner; a share request's to both the school or NGO and the donor.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.service.DocumentQueryService
comment: Document lists for the screens, with organisation, type and cause/project names filled in.

methods.name: documentsOf
methods.comment: Current versions of an organisation's documents: the person's own organisation, or any for staff.

methods.name: reviewQueue
methods.comment: Staff review queue: newest version of every document still waiting, oldest first.

methods.name: shareRequestsOf
methods.comment: Requests a donor made, or requests a school or NGO received.

methods.name: downloadUrl
methods.comment: Checks the access policy, then returns a link that works for five minutes.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.service.DocumentTypeAdminService
comment: Super admins: document types and which organisation types must provide each. A change to the mandatory rules publishes MandatoryRulesChanged, so the registry re-checks the organisations of the affected types.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.service.LegacyFileCopier
comment: Copies the old /uploads files into object storage after V100 has created the document rows. Safe to run again: only rows still at size 0 are copied. Missing files are listed, not fatal.

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.util.DocumentAccessPolicy
comment: Who may open a document (fixes S2). Pure, unit-tested. - staff: always - the owning organisation: always - a donor: only shareable documents, only with an APPROVED share request from the owner - anyone else: never

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.util.MandatoryRuleChange
comment: Pure: which organisation types are affected when a document type's mandatory set changes (to re-check verification).

name: org.humsaadhak.documents.util.UploadPolicy
comment: What may be uploaded: allow-listed types, checked by extension AND by the file's first bytes. Pure.

name: org.humsaadhak.giving.api
comment: The giving module's public interface: the only types other modules may use (checked by ModularityTests).

name: org.humsaadhak.giving.controller.GivingController
comment: Recording donations (with an Idempotency-Key so a retried request never records twice) and a donor's own list.

methods.name: record
methods.comment: Records a donation exactly once per idempotency key (a double click cannot pay twice).

methods.name: donationsOf
methods.comment: The signed-in donor's own donations, newest first.

name: org.humsaadhak.giving.service.GivingAuditOwnership
comment: A donation's trail belongs to the donor and to the school or NGO it was paid to.

name: org.humsaadhak.giving.service.InstalmentScheduler
comment: Fixes D5: runs daily for every periodicity (no hard-coded filters), once per cluster (ShedLock), and reminds each instalment at most once.

name: org.humsaadhak.giving.util.DonationCalculator
comment: Donation arithmetic in one place (pure, unit-tested). Fixes D4: paid and pledged are separate numbers; the variance is derived, never stored in a column called "amount".

methods.name: cycleStart
methods.comment: Start of the current commitment cycle: calendar month, or quarter / half / year of the Indian financial year (from 1 April).

methods.name: rupees
methods.comment: ₹ with Indian digit grouping, e.g. ₹4,50,000.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.api
comment: The identity module's public interface: the only types other modules may use (checked by ModularityTests).

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.api.InvitationLinks
comment: Creates a fresh single-use link at the moment an email is composed, so no token ever sits in an event table.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.api.Theme
comment: The four colour themes a user can pick in Settings; stored per user so it follows them across devices.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.api.UserActivated
comment: A manager approved a new user; notifications sends the invitation. Ids only, never secrets.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.api.UserDirectory
comment: Active people of an organisation, for notifications.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.config.BootstrapAdmin
comment: Creates the first super admin on a fresh installation without any default password. Set HUMSAADHAK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL; on first start the account is created and an invitation (single-use, 72-hour set-password link) is emailed. Does nothing once any super admin exists.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.config.SecurityConfig
comment: Same-origin SPA security: server-side session in an HttpOnly cookie (Spring Session JDBC), CSRF token in a readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie that the React client echoes in X-XSRF-TOKEN. Every API call needs a session except sign-up, login and password links. Fixes S1 and S6.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.controller.AccessController
comment: Roles and permissions screen (super admins). The role list is also read by the Users screen.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.controller.AdminUserController
comment: Users screen (super admins).

methods.name: login
methods.comment: Signs in and starts a new session (the session id changes, against session fixation).

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.controller.PreferencesController
comment: Personal settings of the signed-in person.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.dao.AccessDao
comment: Roles, permissions, their grants and the access change log (tables from V6__roles_permissions.sql).

methods.name: roleNameTaken
methods.comment: Whether another role (not exceptCode) already uses this name, ignoring case.

methods.name: grantsByRole
methods.comment: role code -> granted permission codes

methods.name: roleNamesByPermission
methods.comment: permission code -> names of the roles that grant it

methods.name: permissionNames
methods.comment: permission code -> name

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.comment: Deletes a permission; its grants go with it (on delete cascade).

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.dao.SessionDao
comment: Spring Session's store (tables from V6): sessions are indexed by the signed-in email in principal_name.

methods.name: deleteSessionsOf
methods.comment: Deletes every session of these people (their attributes go with them, on delete cascade).

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.dto.MeResponse
comment: role = account type (data scope, dashboard); roleCode/roleName = the assigned role; permissions = what it grants.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.dto.NewStaffBody
comment: A new HumSaadhak staff member (Users screen, "Add staff member").

methods.name: assignRole
methods.comment: Assigns a role; the account type follows the role's kind.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.entity.OneTimeToken
comment: Invitation or password-reset token. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored; the raw value lives in the email.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.AccessService
comment: Roles and permissions: rules (RolePolicy), the change log, and signing out the people a change affects so their new rights apply at once. Storage is in AccessDao.

methods.name: log
methods.comment: Records a change made elsewhere (e.g. a person's role changed on the Users screen).

methods.name: logChange
methods.comment: Writes the access change log and adds the same details to this request's audit record.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.AccountService
comment: Sign-up, approval follow-up and passwords. Fixes S3 (no temporary password, nothing secret logged) and S5 (tokens expire and are single-use).

methods.name: on
methods.comment: A manager decided on a USER approval request.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.comment: Works for both the invitation and the reset link.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.comment: Always succeeds from the caller's view so the endpoint cannot be used to discover accounts.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.AppUserDetailsService
comment: Loads a person for sign-in with the permissions of their assigned role, read from the database (AccessService). The principal is a small serialisable snapshot (never the JPA entity), because Spring Session stores it in the database.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.AuthService
comment: Sign-in rules: lock an account after repeated failures (AppUser.MAX_FAILED_LOGINS) and reset the count on success.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.IdentityAuditOwnership
comment: A person's trail (sign-ins, role changes, settings) belongs to their organisation; staff accounts to staff only.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.PreferencesService
comment: Personal settings saved on the account (today: the colour theme), so they are the same on every device.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.SessionRevoker
comment: Signs people out everywhere, so a change to their role or its permissions applies immediately.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.service.UserAdminService
comment: Super admins: search users, change their role, disable or enable accounts, resend invitations.

methods.name: changeRole
methods.comment: Gives a person any role (built-in or custom) that fits their account; they are signed out so it applies at once.

methods.name: createStaff
methods.comment: Adds a HumSaadhak staff member (manager, associate, super admin or a custom staff role). Staff do not register themselves: the account is created active without a password and the person is emailed a single-use set-password link.

methods.name: resendInvitation
methods.comment: Sends a fresh single-use set-password link (for example when the first one expired).

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.util.PasswordPolicy
comment: Password rules shared by the server and the set-password screen (frontend passwordRules.ts mirrors this): at least 12 characters, not only letters, and not containing the email's name part.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.util.RolePolicy
comment: Rules for administering roles and permissions (pure, unit-tested): - system roles and permissions come from the application and cannot be deleted or renamed; - the Super admin role always keeps "Manage users" and "Manage roles and permissions", so nobody can lock everyone out; - a role in use cannot be deleted; a custom role has an account type that matches the people who will hold it; - custom permission codes look like "reports.view" (lower case, dot separated) and never reuse a code.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.comment: Checks a new permission set for a role; unknown codes and lock-outs are refused.

methods.name: describeChange
methods.comment: "Added: Approve records; Removed: Bulk import" for the change log.

methods.name: kindLabel
methods.comment: The words people use for each account type.

methods.name: fits
methods.comment: Whether someone whose organisation is of orgType (null for staff) may hold a role of this kind: staff roles need no organisation; donor, school and NGO roles need an organisation of that type.

name: org.humsaadhak.identity.util.TokenHasher
comment: Random URL-safe tokens and their SHA-256 hashes.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer
comment: Bulk Excel import (replaces the legacy multi-sheet uploads). A file is validated row by row first; if any row is wrong nothing is saved and every problem is reported with its row and column.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer.controller.ImportController
comment: Bulk Excel import of purposes, causes and projects (all-or-nothing), recent jobs and templates.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer.dao.ImportLookupDao
comment: Reference values the importer validates rows against.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer.model.ImportType
comment: What can be imported, with the exact column headers of each template.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer.service.ImportService
comment: Validate everything first; create only when every row is valid (all-or-nothing).

methods.name: upload
methods.comment: Runs an import and returns the job with any row errors. Transactional here because this is the entry point: the call to run() below is inside this class, so it does not pass through Spring's transaction proxy.

methods.name: template
methods.comment: An empty Excel template with the right columns for this kind of import.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer.util.RowValidator
comment: Checks one spreadsheet row and converts its text to typed values (pure, unit-tested). Accepts what people actually type: "4,50,000", "₹4,50,000", "One-time", "half yearly", "Cause".

methods.name: parseAmount
methods.comment: "₹4,50,000.50" -> 450000.50; null when blank or not a number.

methods.name: parsePeriodicity
methods.comment: "One-time", "one time", "HALF_YEARLY", "Half-yearly", "Annual" -> enum.

name: org.humsaadhak.importer.util.WorkbookIO
comment: Reads the first sheet of an .xlsx into rows keyed by header, and writes import templates.

name: org.humsaadhak.matching.api
comment: The matching module's public interface: the only types other modules may use (checked by ModularityTests).

name: org.humsaadhak.matching.client.SearchClient
comment: Talks to the Python humsaadhak-search service. Results are keyed by entity id, never by list position (fixes D1). Internal network only; authenticated with a shared service token.

name: org.humsaadhak.matching.controller.MatchingController
comment: Matching runs, reviewing candidates, confirmed matches and suggested donors.

name: org.humsaadhak.matching.dto.SuggestedBenefactor
comment: Reverse search: purposes (and so benefactors) that fit a need. Shown to its owner and to staff.

methods.name: run
methods.comment: Runs the engine for approved purposes; stores new candidates at or above the store threshold.

methods.name: confirm
methods.comment: All-or-nothing confirmation of a purpose's shown candidates.

methods.name: on
methods.comment: Keeps the search index in step with approvals and funding (after commit, retried on failure).

methods.name: candidateRows
methods.comment: Candidates still to review for a purpose, with what the screens show about each cause or project.

methods.name: matchesOfPurpose
methods.comment: Confirmed matches of a purpose in priority order; donors see only their own.

methods.name: suggestions
methods.comment: Donors whose approved purposes fit a cause or project (staff, or the school or NGO that owns it).

name: org.humsaadhak.matching.util.CandidateDecisionValidator
comment: Rules for confirming a purpose's candidates (pure, unit-tested). Mirrors the legacy review screen and adds what it missed: - every shown candidate must be decided (no silent leftovers) - every rejection needs a remark (it becomes a training label) - approved candidates carry priorities 1..n with no gaps or repeats (the order the donor sees) - at least one approval

name: org.humsaadhak.notifications.client.GraphMailGateway
comment: Sends through Microsoft Graph (the tenant the current system already uses) with the client-credentials flow. Credentials come from environment variables only (S4). redirect-to sends every mail to one inbox outside production.

name: org.humsaadhak.notifications.client.LoggingMailGateway
comment: Development and trial default: logs recipients and subject only. Bodies hold one-time links, so they are never logged, unless MAIL_LOG_LINKS=true: then the links are logged too, so a trial on localhost can be signed into without email (deploy/deploy.sh admin-link reads them). Never enable that where real people have accounts.

name: org.humsaadhak.notifications.service.NotificationListeners
comment: Every email the platform sends. Runs after commit; Spring Modulith retries failures.

name: org.humsaadhak.notifications.util.MailLinks
comment: The links in an email body (pure, unit-tested): what a trial deployment logs so people can sign in without real email.

name: org.humsaadhak.referencedata.controller.ReferenceController
comment: Public lookups for forms. Cached by the browser for a day.

name: org.humsaadhak.referencedata.controller.SectorAdminController
comment: Super admins: sectors (add, rename while unused, switch off).

name: org.humsaadhak.referencedata.dao.ReferenceDataDao
comment: Active reference data for forms.

name: org.humsaadhak.referencedata.dao.SectorDao
comment: Sectors with how many purposes, causes and projects use each (they store the sector name).

name: org.humsaadhak.referencedata.service.ReferenceDataService
comment: Choices offered by forms: periodicities, active sectors, states and active document types.

name: org.humsaadhak.referencedata.service.SectorService
comment: Super admins add sectors, rename unused ones, and switch sectors off. Purposes and needs store the sector name, so a sector already in use is never renamed or deleted (that would orphan records); it can be switched off instead, which hides it from new forms while existing records keep it.

name: org.humsaadhak.registry.api
comment: The registry module's public interface: the only types other modules may use (checked by ModularityTests).

name: org.humsaadhak.registry.api.OrganisationType
comment: One table for all organisations replaces benefactor / db_beneficiary / indirect_beneficiary.

methods.name: findOrCreateForRegistration
methods.comment: Joins an existing verified organisation of the same name and type, or creates a new one.

methods.name: idByRefNo
methods.comment: For imports: "BN100045" -> organisation id.

name: org.humsaadhak.registry.controller.OrganisationController
comment: Organisations: staff list; profile, contacts and bank accounts of one organisation.

methods.name: replaceContacts
methods.comment: Replaces the whole contact list in one go (the form sends every row).

methods.name: maskedNumber
methods.comment: Shown everywhere except to staff with the reveal permission (S-series: PAN and bank numbers masked).

name: org.humsaadhak.registry.entity.OrgContact
comment: Any number of contacts per organisation, replacing signatory_1 / signatory_2 columns.

name: org.humsaadhak.registry.service.OrganisationDirectoryAdapter
comment: Registry's implementation of the names lookup that the documents module declares (dependency inversion).

name: org.humsaadhak.registry.service.OrganisationProfileService

name: org.humsaadhak.reporting.dao.BeneficiaryReportQuery
comment: The beneficiary reports of the original project (Donation, Match, Project/Cause and Customize Project/Cause reports), rebuilt safely. Pure and unit-tested.  The original custom report assembled SQL from the column_mapping/join_mapping tables (security finding S7). Here every column, join and filter is a constant in this class; a request can only switch columns on (by enum name) and give filter values, which are bound as parameters. The original's project/cause totals joined matches and donations in one query and so double-counted; here each total is its own subquery.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.AuditAction
comment:
Marks a controller method as a user action to record in the audit trail. Every state-changing endpoint must carry it (LayeredArchitectureTest), and so must sensitive reads such as document downloads and exports.

The action and its audit record are committed in one transaction; a refused or failed attempt is recorded on its own after the rollback. Expressions are SpEL over the method's parameter names (#id, #body) and, once the method has returned, #result. They are written by developers, never taken from requests.

methods.name: value
methods.comment: "category.verb", e.g. "purpose.update"; the category groups actions on the pages that show them.

methods.name: target
methods.comment: What kind of record the action is about.

methods.name: id
methods.comment: SpEL for the record's id, e.g. "#id" or "#result.id()". Services may also set it with AuditContext.target.

methods.name: detail
methods.comment: SpEL for a short, non-secret description, e.g. "#body.comment()". Never passwords or tokens.

methods.name: transactional
methods.comment: False for sign-in, sign-out and read-only actions: these are recorded after the method instead of in its transaction.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.AuditContext
comment: What the audit trail knows about the current request: its id, where it came from, and anything a service adds while handling it (the id of a record it just created, the subject of an approval, a short note). One per request thread.

methods.name: target
methods.comment: For services: the record this request acted on, when only the service knows it (a new record, an approval's subject).

methods.name: note
methods.comment: For services: a short, non-secret note added to this request's audit record.

methods.name: requestIdOrNull
methods.comment: The id shared by this request's audit record and the change history it wrote, or null outside a request.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.AuditOwnership
comment: Implemented by each module for the records it owns: which organisations' people may see a record's audit trail (the donor of a purpose, the school of a cause, both sides of a share request). Staff may always see it.

methods.name: organisations
methods.comment: Organisations that own or share the record; empty when it no longer exists or belongs to staff only.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.CurrentUser
comment: The signed-in person, as every module sees them.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.CurrentUser$Principal
comment: Implemented by the identity module's UserDetails so other modules never see it.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.InternalTls
comment: How HumSaadhak's clients verify the servers they call (search service, file storage): the internal CA from TLS_CA_FILE plus the usual public CAs, or the public CAs alone when no internal CA is configured.

methods.name: httpClient
methods.comment: A JDK HTTP client that speaks TLS 1.3/1.2 only and verifies certificate and hostname.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.Permission
comment: Fine-grained permissions checked by code. Roles are bundles of these (see Role).

methods.name: authority
methods.comment: The Spring Security authority string, e.g. "perm:match.run".

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.security.Role
comment: The account type: staff, individual or corporate donor, school, NGO or guest. It decides whose data a person works with and which dashboard they see. What they may do comes from the permissions of their assigned role, which super admins manage (app_role / app_role_permission); the sets below are the starting permissions of the system roles, seeded by V6 (RoleSeedTest checks the two stay the same).

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.Codes
comment: Stable codes for reference data typed by administrators: "Fire-safety certificate" -> "FIRE_SAFETY_CERTIFICATE".

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.Csv
comment: CSV for spreadsheet users (RFC 4180): quoted where needed, CRLF line ends and a UTF-8 byte-order mark so Excel shows ₹ and Indian names correctly. Cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with ' so a spreadsheet never runs them as formulas (CSV injection).

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.FieldEncryptor
comment: AES-256-GCM for sensitive columns (bank account numbers). Stored form: "v1:" + base64(iv || ciphertext+tag). A fresh random IV per value means equal inputs never produce equal outputs. Values without the prefix are returned unchanged so existing plain rows keep working until they are re-saved.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.IndianRupees
comment: ₹ with Indian digit grouping (₹12,40,000). Shared so every module formats money the same way.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.RefNo
comment: Business reference numbers shown to people (BN100045, DN100046 …). Same rule as the legacy system so existing numbers stay valid: prefix + (100000 + database id).

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.TlsSupport
comment: TLS material for encryption in transit between HumSaadhak's services (pure JDK, unit-tested with a real TLS server). Only TLS 1.3 and 1.2 are offered, and clients always verify the server's certificate and hostname.

methods.name: readCertificates
methods.comment: Every certificate in a PEM file.

methods.name: trustManager
methods.comment: Trusts the CA certificates in the PEM file and, when alsoPublicCas is true, the JDK's usual public CAs too (so the same client still reaches Microsoft Graph or AWS). The JDK's own trust manager does the checking.

methods.name: systemTrustManager
methods.comment: The JDK's default trust manager (public CAs only).

methods.name: clientContext
methods.comment: Client-side context: verifies servers with the given trust manager.

methods.name: serverContext
methods.comment: Server-side context from a PEM certificate chain and a PKCS#8 private key (as written by deploy/tls/make-certs.sh).

methods.name: clientParameters
methods.comment: TLS 1.3/1.2 only, and the hostname must match the certificate (HTTPS endpoint identification).

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.TransportSecurityPolicy
comment: Encryption in transit, as a checklist over the application's connection settings (pure, unit-tested). With humsaadhak.security.require-tls=true the application refuses to start while anything on this list is unencrypted.

methods.name: jdbcParam
methods.comment: A query parameter of a JDBC URL, lower case, or null.

name: org.humsaadhak.shared.util.TransportSecurityPolicy$Settings
comment: The connection settings that decide whether data travels encrypted.

name: org.humsaadhak.workflow.util.ApprovalPolicy
comment: The maker-checker rules in one place (pure Java, unit-tested). - submit: from DRAFT or REJECTED, by the maker - approve / reject: only from SUBMITTED, never by the maker - reject: a comment is required - material edit of an APPROVED record: back to SUBMITTED as a new revision
